lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoRhP₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—4 Co, 4 Rh, and 8 P—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows P centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Co and Rh centers each have 8 P neighbors in body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and Rh 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing among P 12-vertex polyhedra.
